CommunityApplications.Profile:
**PeriodiCool** is a self-hosted manager for magazines, made to work alongside the *arr suite (Prowlarr, SABnzbd, qBittorrent and friends). Add the magazines you read; it works out which issues should exist, watches your indexers for new and back issues, sends them to your download client, and files them in your library under clean names.
**Beta, in active development.** It runs on the maintainer's Unraid server with Prowlarr and SABnzbd. The other download clients follow their documented APIs and are tested against simulations, not real installs yet. Back up /config before updating, and run the library scan as a preview before letting it touch an existing collection: it never deletes library files, only moves and renames them.
It ships no content and no indexers; you bring your own.
Support, bug reports and ideas: GitHub issues. Contributions, forks and honest feedback (including "this is trash") are welcome.
